description: This Python source file contains utility functions for extracting GUI component and screen terms from JSON data, checking for specific terms in code files, and mapping terms to source files within a project.

methods.name: extract_sc_terms
methods.description: Extracts screen component terms from JSON string, focusing on the last few steps of execution trace.

methods.name: extract_gs_terms
methods.description: Extracts GUI screen terms from JSON string, focusing on activity and window names.

methods.name: check_if_sc_term_exists
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified search terms exist within a file's content.

methods.name: build_corpus
methods.description: Maps screen component terms to source code files using a brute-force search.

methods.name: get_boosted_files
methods.description: Maps GUI screen terms to source code files based on filename matching.
